INSERT INTO ops.workflow_runs
  (workflow_code, source_code, n8n_execution_id, trigger_type, status, started_at, error_details, metadata, created_at, updated_at)
VALUES
  ('WF-019', 'SECOP_PIPELINE_ORCHESTRATION', $1::TEXT, $2::TEXT, 'running', NOW(), '{}'::JSONB,
   jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object('workflow_code', 'WF-019', 'organization_id', NULLIF($3::TEXT, ''),
     'requested_by_user_id', NULLIF($4::TEXT, ''), 'process_id', NULLIF($5::TEXT, ''),
     'processing_mode', $6::TEXT, 'orchestration_version', 2, 'started_at', NOW())), NOW(), NOW())
ON CONFLICT (n8n_execution_id) DO UPDATE SET
  status = 'running', started_at = NOW(), finished_at = NULL, completion_reason = NULL,
  error_node = NULL, error_message = NULL, error_details = '{}'::JSONB,
  metadata = COALESCE(ops.workflow_runs.metadata, '{}'::JSONB) || EXCLUDED.metadata, updated_at = NOW()
RETURNING id AS workflow_run_id, workflow_code, n8n_execution_id, status AS workflow_run_status, started_at;

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO ops.sync_cursors
(
    source_code,
    status,

    active_execution_id,
    lock_acquired_at,
    lock_expires_at,

    error_message,

    metadata,

    updated_at
)

VALUES
(
    $1::TEXT,

    'idle',

    NULL,
    NULL,
    NULL,

    NULL,

    jsonb_build_object(
        'workflow_code',
        'WF-019',

        'source_code',
        $1::TEXT,

        'initialized_by',
        'WF-019',

        'initialized_at',
        NOW()
    ),

    NOW()
)

ON CONFLICT
(
    source_code
)

DO UPDATE

SET
    metadata =
        COALESCE(
            ops.sync_cursors.metadata,
            '{}'::JSONB
        )
        ||
        jsonb_build_object(
            'workflow_code',
            'WF-019',

            'last_initialized_at',
            NOW(),

            'last_initialized_by',
            'WF-018'
        ),

    updated_at =
        NOW()

RETURNING
    source_code,
    status,

    active_execution_id,

    lock_acquired_at,
    lock_expires_at,

    error_message,

    metadata,

    updated_at;

WITH stale_cursor AS
(
    SELECT
        cursor.source_code,
        cursor.active_execution_id

    FROM ops.sync_cursors
        AS cursor

    WHERE cursor.source_code =
          $1::TEXT

      AND cursor.active_execution_id
          IS NOT NULL

      AND
      (
          cursor.lock_expires_at
              IS NULL

          OR

          cursor.lock_expires_at
              < NOW()

          OR

          cursor.lock_acquired_at
              <
              NOW()
              -
              (
                  $2::INTEGER
                  * INTERVAL '1 minute'
              )
      )

    LIMIT 1
),

closed_run AS
(
    UPDATE ops.workflow_runs
        AS run

    SET
        status =
            'failed',

        finished_at =
            NOW(),

        completion_reason =
            'stale_lock_recovery',

        error_message =
            'WF-019 recuperó un bloqueo vencido.',

        error_details =
            COALESCE(
                run.error_details,
                '{}'::JSONB
            )
            ||
            jsonb_build_object(
                'recovery_type',
                'stale_lock',

                'recovered_by',
                'WF-019',

                'recovered_at',
                NOW()
            ),

        updated_at =
            NOW()

    FROM stale_cursor
        AS stale

    WHERE run.workflow_code =
          'WF-019'

      AND run.n8n_execution_id =
          stale.active_execution_id::TEXT

      AND run.status =
          'running'

    RETURNING
        run.id
),

recovered_cursor AS
(
    UPDATE ops.sync_cursors
        AS cursor

    SET
        status =
            'error',

        active_execution_id =
            NULL,

        lock_acquired_at =
            NULL,

        lock_expires_at =
            NULL,

        error_message =
            'Stale lock recovered by WF-019',

        metadata =
            (
                COALESCE(
                    cursor.metadata,
                    '{}'::JSONB
                )
                - 'active_workflow'
                - 'active_execution_id'
                - 'active_execution_started_at'
            )
            ||
            jsonb_build_object(
                'stale_lock_recovered',
                TRUE,

                'stale_lock_recovered_at',
                NOW(),

                'stale_lock_recovered_by',
                'WF-019'
            ),

        updated_at =
            NOW()

    FROM stale_cursor
        AS stale

    WHERE cursor.source_code =
          stale.source_code

      AND cursor.active_execution_id =
          stale.active_execution_id

    RETURNING
        cursor.source_code
)

SELECT
    EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM stale_cursor
    )
        AS stale_lock_found,

    EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM closed_run
    )
        AS workflow_run_closed,

    EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM recovered_cursor
    )
        AS lock_recovered,

    cursor.source_code,

    cursor.status
        AS cursor_status,

    cursor.active_execution_id,

    cursor.lock_acquired_at,

    cursor.lock_expires_at,

    cursor.error_message,

    cursor.updated_at

FROM ops.sync_cursors
    AS cursor

WHERE cursor.source_code =
      $1::TEXT;

WITH lock_attempt AS
(
    UPDATE ops.sync_cursors
        AS cursor

    SET
        status =
            'running',

        active_execution_id =
            $2::TEXT,

        lock_acquired_at =
            NOW(),

        lock_expires_at =
            NOW()
            +
            (
                $3::INTEGER
                * INTERVAL '1 minute'
            ),

        error_message =
            NULL,

        metadata =
            COALESCE(
                cursor.metadata,
                '{}'::JSONB
            )
            ||
            jsonb_build_object(
                'active_workflow',
                'WF-019',

                'active_execution_id',
                $2::TEXT,

                'active_execution_started_at',
                NOW(),

                'plan_version',
                1,

                'generation_method',
                'deterministic_v1'
            ),

        updated_at =
            NOW()

    WHERE cursor.source_code =
          $1::TEXT

      AND
      (
          cursor.active_execution_id
              IS NULL

          OR

          cursor.lock_expires_at
              IS NULL

          OR

          cursor.lock_expires_at
              < NOW()

          OR

          cursor.active_execution_id::TEXT =
              $2::TEXT
      )

    RETURNING
        cursor.source_code,

        cursor.status,

        cursor.active_execution_id,

        cursor.lock_acquired_at,

        cursor.lock_expires_at,

        cursor.error_message,

        cursor.updated_at
)

SELECT
    TRUE
        AS lock_acquired,

    acquired.source_code,

    acquired.status
        AS cursor_status,

    acquired.active_execution_id,

    acquired.lock_acquired_at,

    acquired.lock_expires_at,

    acquired.error_message,

    acquired.updated_at

FROM lock_attempt
    AS acquired


UNION ALL


SELECT
    FALSE
        AS lock_acquired,

    cursor.source_code,

    cursor.status
        AS cursor_status,

    cursor.active_execution_id,

    cursor.lock_acquired_at,

    cursor.lock_expires_at,

    cursor.error_message,

    cursor.updated_at

FROM ops.sync_cursors
    AS cursor

WHERE cursor.source_code =
      $1::TEXT

  AND NOT EXISTS
  (
      SELECT 1
      FROM lock_attempt
  )

LIMIT 1;

UPDATE ops.workflow_runs
SET status = 'success', finished_at = NOW(), completion_reason = 'pipeline_completed',
    error_node = NULL, error_message = NULL,
    error_details = COALESCE(error_details, '{}'::JSONB) || jsonb_build_object(
      'pipeline_completed', TRUE, 'orchestration_version', 2, 'last_stage', 'WF-018',
      'completed_stages', $2::JSONB, 'completed_at', NOW()),
    metadata = COALESCE(metadata, '{}'::JSONB) || jsonb_build_object(
      'pipeline_status', 'READY_FOR_FRONTEND', 'last_successful_stage', 'WF-018',
      'ready_for_frontend', TRUE, 'orchestration_completed_at', NOW()), updated_at = NOW()
WHERE workflow_code = 'WF-019' AND n8n_execution_id = $1::TEXT AND status = 'running'
RETURNING id AS workflow_run_id, workflow_code, n8n_execution_id, status AS workflow_run_status,
          started_at, finished_at, completion_reason, metadata ->> 'pipeline_status' AS pipeline_status, TRUE AS orchestration_finalized;

WITH released_cursor AS
(
    UPDATE ops.sync_cursors
        AS cursor

    SET
        status =
            'success',

        active_execution_id =
            NULL,

        lock_acquired_at =
            NULL,

        lock_expires_at =
            NULL,

        error_message =
            NULL,

        metadata =
            (
                COALESCE(
                    cursor.metadata,
                    '{}'::JSONB
                )

                - 'active_workflow'
                - 'active_execution_id'
                - 'active_execution_started_at'
            )
            ||
            jsonb_build_object(
                'last_successful_workflow',
                'WF-019',

                'last_successful_execution_id',
                $2::TEXT,

                'last_successful_finished_at',
                NOW(),

                'orchestration_version',
                1,

                'orchestration_method',
                'sequential_v1',

                'pipeline_status',
                'READY_FOR_FRONTEND',

                'lock_released',
                TRUE
            ),

        updated_at =
            NOW()

    WHERE cursor.source_code =
          $1::TEXT

      AND cursor.active_execution_id::TEXT =
          $2::TEXT

    RETURNING
        cursor.source_code,
        cursor.status,
        cursor.active_execution_id,
        cursor.lock_acquired_at,
        cursor.lock_expires_at,
        cursor.error_message,
        cursor.updated_at
)

SELECT
    TRUE
        AS lock_released,

    released.source_code,

    released.status
        AS cursor_status,

    released.active_execution_id,

    released.lock_acquired_at,

    released.lock_expires_at,

    released.error_message,

    released.updated_at

FROM released_cursor
    AS released


UNION ALL


SELECT
    FALSE
        AS lock_released,

    cursor.source_code,

    cursor.status
        AS cursor_status,

    cursor.active_execution_id,

    cursor.lock_acquired_at,

    cursor.lock_expires_at,

    cursor.error_message,

    cursor.updated_at

FROM ops.sync_cursors
    AS cursor

WHERE cursor.source_code =
      $1::TEXT

  AND NOT EXISTS
  (
      SELECT 1
      FROM released_cursor
  )

LIMIT 1;
